acceptanceCriteria: Opt-in load harness run at >=45,000 receipts on a quieter host, results retained with host/load/version.
Spec CAL-V0-335 bound updated to measured values or the gap retained.
body: Found by lane V1-1560 (PR beamfall/corvint#1018, head c843d6aab, GitHub #1010) on 2026-10-17. Measured only at 10,000 receipts on darwin under load 53-68 (18/18 acquires, max 65.2s, 0 SNAPSHOT_MOVED). The #1010 bound of 45,000 receipts (setup ~15 min at this load) and a Linux run were NOT_RUN; extrapolated prefix walk ~3 min there, so the 2-minute bound is unmeasured at 45k.
title: Qualify pool acquire starvation fix at 45,000 receipts and on Linux
